messages:
Marta: Quick follow-up on the pinning/rollout metadata RFC — two small open items: how we encode affinity vs entropy and what minimal telemetry we need for pin lifecycle. Proposal below.

Noah: ack. can you sketch the fields? worried about schema bloat and client compatibility.

Marta: Sketch (very compact):
```json
{
  "pin_kind": "hard|soft|prefer",  // semantics: hard blocks eviction, soft is a best-effort affinity
  "lease_ttl": 3600,                // seconds; 0 = sticky until manual unpin
  "stability_score": 0.0-1.0,       // heuristic score used by resolver to prefer replicas
  "fallback_priority": ["variant-a","variant-b"],
  "entropy_tag": "region/us-west-2|workload/billing", // optional routing hint
  "compat_version": "1"           // schema version for graceful migration
}
```
This is intentionally small so we can keep payloads tiny for tenant pins. Also suggest a compact TLV envelope for transport where we need to attach extra provenance: tag=0x01(pin_kind),0x02(lease),0x03(stability) — decodes fast in C++ runtime.

Kevin: Hard vs soft semantics make sense. two questions: (1) if a soft pin conflicts with capacity, do we evict it? (2) how do we prevent noisy churn from tiny stability_score changes?

Marta: (1) soft pins are advisory — runtime may evict when violating SLOs. We record a "fallback_used" event when eviction happens. (2) add hysteresis: only treat stability_score delta > 0.15 as meaningful for pin reshuffle. Keep that logic in runtime not in schema.

Anya: Observability needs: pin_applied, pin_refreshed, pin_evicted, fallback_used, pin_owner (hash), sample_rate. We should also emit rollouts as spans so traces show resolver decisions. Without owner hash we can't attribute leaks.

Noah: Compatibility: older clients will send plain string pins. Plan: accept both formats and expose compat_version. Migration path: server reads compat_version, decodes TLV if present, otherwise treat as legacy "soft" pin with lease_ttl=0. Add a 6wk migration window for clients to upgrade.

Kevin: Perf: TLV decode must be micro-optimized. please bench on 128k pins/sec scenario. Also ensure base64 length limits in DB index (use 256 char cap).

deploy-bot: :rocket: canary deploy started for model-resolver v1.12 -> prod (canary 10% traffic).

Marta: For rollout metadata semantics I also propose two new conventions: (A) "pin_intent" optional freeform string to explain why (e.g., "regression-fix-2026-03-15"), (B) a tiny immutable provenance blob `prov_id` (8 bytes) that we use in telemetry for deduping. Both are optional.

Anya: +1 on prov_id. also: add an indexable boolean `tenant_managed` so the UI can prevent accidental automated evictions.

Noah: SGTM. I'll help with the TLV decoding PR and add decoder fuzz tests.

Kevin: +1 — i'll run perf once PR lands.

Marta: I'll open a PR with a minimal JSON schema, TLV spec appendix, a short migration plan and unit tests. assigning to @Noah and @Kevin for review. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, I'll merge the RFC follow-up into the rollout metadata repo. :+1:
